requirements.title: The application shall record today's completion when the "Done today" toggle button is clicked

vision.paraphrase: Serves goal G2 — completing a habit for today is a single press of the row's check-in button, and the recorded state outlasts a reload or restart.

conops.paraphrase: Pressing the row's "Done today" button is the entire daily ritual — the app's core interaction, kept down to one act.

requirements.title: The application shall remove today's completion when an already-done "Done today" toggle button is clicked again

vision.paraphrase: The check-in control is deliberately reversible — a mistaken completion can be taken back on the spot, with the streak recomputed to match.

conops.paraphrase: The same button that records the day must also be able to reverse it within the same sitting, so check-in state is always correctable.

requirements.title: The application shall record at most one completion per habit per local calendar day, regardless of repeated clicks or reloads

vision.paraphrase: Completions are a set of unique local dates — one entry per day, by construction.

conops.paraphrase: Repeated interactions with the same day must never inflate the history.

requirements.title: The application shall record completions as local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in the user's timezone, not UTC dates

vision.paraphrase: Each completion is keyed by the local calendar date on which it happened, written in YYYY-MM-DD form.

conops.paraphrase: Streak arithmetic runs on the user's local days (ConOps §8); anchoring check-ins to UTC would shift the day boundary for anyone far from UTC.
